Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/23577
Compromised employee credentials -> hacking Use of stolen creds (vector Unknown). Data victim Employee (direct deposit details). 'Could have accessed' -> data_disclosure Potentially. Count 446 = sum of TX, MA, NH filings -> amount only. Discovery and containment same day. NAICS 3254 -> 325412. Employee count 10001 to 25000 (US unit, approximate).
Credentials added to attribute.confidentiality.data on 2026-11-19 per analyst rule: Hacking 'Use of stolen creds' requires Credentials as a compromised data variety (amount unknown).

summary: An unauthorized third party compromised a Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA employee's credentials; Takeda found and contained it on February 23, 2026. On April 24 it determined personal information could have been accessed: names, dates of birth, addresses, Social Security, driver's license and passport/state ID numbers, direct deposit banking details and medical records. Letters went out from May 29, 2026; state filings list 446 people (392 in Texas).
